mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in the housing sector that reduces aggregate consumer spending, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint demand channel.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 during Q1 quarters signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to sector-specific earnings pressure.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of Q1 INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 1.5% annualized signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of GDPC1 < 1.5% periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y) triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations that increase real interest rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth above 150,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of PAYEMS > 150k periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Three consecutive months of industrial production below 100 indicate manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 for 3 months periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
